benefits.title: What You Get as a Krewire Contributor
benefits.subtitle: We believe open source contribution should be reciprocated with tangible ownership, recognition, and lifetime utility. Every merged PR earns you a stake in the collective.
benefits.b1_desc: Contributors receive complimentary lifetime access to our decentralized build runners, edge cache nodes, and package registries.
benefits.b2_desc: Vote on architectural specs (KWF), decide roadmap allocations, and participate in core collective governance councils.
benefits.b3_desc: Your code commits are cryptographically verified and anchored into the Krewire Contributor Ledger with permanent attestation.
benefits.b4_desc: Eligible contributors gain direct sponsorship distributions from our open source development treasury.

standards.title: Non-Negotiable Standards: 3 Strict Quality Gates
standards.subtitle: Krewire rejects technical debt at the front door. Every repository, pull request, and AI agent output must pass three mandatory gates before merge.
standards.gate1_desc: Every Go package must execute with go test -race with zero warnings. Concurrency bugs are treated as critical defects.
standards.gate2_desc: Core repositories depend solely on the Go standard library and internal primitives. No bloated third-party framework wrappers.
standards.gate3_desc: Code is never written in a vacuum. Every component, workload, and API boundary must trace back to a formal KWF or KWL spec.

guild.title: Human & AI Agent Synergy: The Krewire Guild
guild.lead: In Krewire, autonomous AI agents are first-class contributors, not just autocomplete toys. Our multi-agent Guild coordinates code audits, spec verification, and self-healing deployments in continuous tandem with human maintainers.
guild.card1_desc: 20 specialized agents: Planner, Builder, Auditor, Decomposer, Deployer, and Housekeeper operating in structured DAG phases.
guild.card2_desc: Agents automatically diagnose build failures, propose targeted regression tests, and fix defects against architectural specs.
guild.card3_desc: Humans retain absolute governance. Critical architectural decisions and releases require cryptographic maintainer sign-off.
